# Toggle

Switch for settings that take effect immediately (notifications, autoplay, dark theme in a settings page).

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Toggle` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Toggle />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Toggle"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Switch (role="switch") for settings that apply immediately. Gradient when on.

## Props (ToggleProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `hint` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `error` | `React.ReactNode` | Error message (replaces hint, red track border). E.g. "Couldn't save. Try again." |
| `checked` | `boolean` | Controlled value. |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | @default false |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Pending: knob shows a spinner, clicks ignored, aria-busy. Use while the setting saves. @default false |
| `loadingLabel` | `string` | Screen-reader text while loading. @default "Saving" |
| `onChange` | `(checked: boolean, e: React.MouseEvent) => void` |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | 36×20 / 44×24. @default "md" |
| `labelPosition` | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'left' \| 'right'` | Label after the switch (end) or before it (start, for settings rows). Follows reading direction. "left"/"right" are aliases. @default "end" |
